chain.text: The depot holds 62 vehicles. The depot employs 140 drivers. The depot was certified in June 2023. The maintenance bay holds 8 lifts. The certification was due for renewal in June 2028. The operations lead is Halvard Onstad. The night shift supervisor is Teodora Blaskovic. Daily departures average 410. The winter peak reached 530 departures. Cancellations run at 1.8 percent. In February 2025, a brake line failed inspection. Nine vehicles were grounded for four days. Every vehicle requires a brake check every 6000 kilometres. In September 2024, the fuel card system was cloned. 4200 euros were lost before it was noticed. A fuel card requires a second approval above 200 euros. A route change requires seven days of notice. An incident report requires filing within 24 hours. The electrification study is approved but unfunded. The second charging bay is scheduled for the third quarter. The old ticketing terminal is still
